exact_review.proof_summary: The prior spectrum must-fix is resolved, and the valid-token and review-scope qualifications are explicit. For X=Y, alpha=1 gives f=(1-beta)I(T:Y). The trine average is I/2 with pure conditionals, attaining the qubit upper bound I=1. For fixed uniform input, classical mutual information is convex in the channel, so a deterministic extreme-point maximizer exists; the best binary partition has entropy h2(1/3). The strict objective gap follows for beta>1. For one-copy label prediction, rho_j<=I gives success<=d/q; the trine POVM sums to I and attains 2/3, as does a binary classical partition. The supplied kernel classifier uses a different access contract, so this equality does not negate its reported utility. A rank-one effect forces every Kraus operator to annihilate the orthogonal complement, yielding a fixed normalized system output on success. Tracing out that output leaves the side-register conditional operator determined only by the effect, without implying loss of side information. EPS smoothing is full rank, so the rank-one conclusion is correctly excluded. In both native branches, conditioning the valid-token cq state on E_EPS yields exactly alpha_t=(p_t+EPS)/sum_s(p_s+EPS); the stated branch-specific spectra are correct. The supplied forward computation consumes probabilities and classical utilities, not instrument outputs, so fixing p, u, mask and bias fixes all 40 logits in exact arithmetic. No unsupported native reachability, novelty, resource advantage or new utility claim is established.
exact_review.scope: Corrected mathematics, supplied original excerpts and exact supplied native source. Empiricalhistory/authenticity/priority outside scope.

must_fix: Explicitly restrict the stated spectrum of E_EPS to the quantum branch, where M_r=|phi_r><phi_r|. The supplied dephased branch instead has M_r=diag(|phi_r,k|^2), so its smoothed eigenvalues are (|phi_r,k|^2+EPS)/(1+EPS), not generally 1 and EPS/(1+EPS). The cq normalization identity and logit invariance still hold in that branch.
